from pathlib import Path

p = Path('/workspace/user_retention_metrics.csv')
df = pd.read_csv(p, parse_dates=['date'])

# Compute metrics
sum_returning = df['returning_users'].sum()
sum_active = df['active_users'].sum()
sum_new = df['new_users'].sum()
avg_churn = df['churn_rate'].mean()

retention_rates = (df['returning_users'] / df['active_users']).round(4)
new_share = (df['new_users'] / df['active_users']).round(4)

overall_retention = (sum_returning / sum_active)

# WoW changes in retention (percentage points)
ret_pp = (retention_rates.diff() * 100).round(1)

summary_lines = []
summary_lines.append('User Retention Summary (latest 5 weeks)')
summary_lines.append('')
summary_lines.append(f"Date range: {df['date'].min().date()} to {df['date'].max().date()}")
summary_lines.append(f"Overall retention rate (returning/active): {overall_retention*100:.1f}%")
summary_lines.append(f"Average weekly churn rate: {avg_churn*100:.1f}% (min {df['churn_rate'].min()*100:.1f}%, max {df['churn_rate'].max()*100:.1f}%)")
summary_lines.append(f"Average weekly active users: {df['active_users'].mean():.0f}")
summary_lines.append(f"Average weekly new users: {df['new_users'].mean():.0f}")
summary_lines.append(f"Average weekly returning users: {df['returning_users'].mean():.0f}")
summary_lines.append('')
summary_lines.append('Weekly metrics:')
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    r = retention_rates.iloc[i]*100
    ns = new_share.iloc[i]*100
    churn = row['churn_rate']*100
    summary_lines.append(f"- {row['date'].date()}: active {row['active_users']}, new {row['new_users']} ({ns:.1f}% of active), returning {row['returning_users']} (retention {r:.1f}%), churn {churn:.1f}%")

summary_lines.append('')
summary_lines.append('Trends:')
summary_lines.append(f"- Retention rose from {retention_rates.iloc[0]*100:.1f}% to {retention_rates.iloc[-1]*100:.1f}% across the period (weekly deltas: {', '.join([f"{v:+.1f}pp" if pd.notna(v) else 'N/A' for v in ret_pp])}).")
summary_lines.append(f"- Active users decreased from {int(df['active_users'].iloc[0])} to {int(df['active_users'].iloc[-1])} ({(df['active_users'].iloc[-1]/df['active_users'].iloc[0]-1)*100:.1f}%).")
summary_lines.append(f"- Churn trended upward from {df['churn_rate'].iloc[0]*100:.1f}% to {df['churn_rate'].iloc[-1]*100:.1f}%, averaging {avg_churn*100:.1f}%.")

out_path = Path('/outputs/user_retention_summary.txt')
out_path.write_text('\n'.join(summary_lines))

'Wrote summary to ' + str(out_path)
